overview.title: Chat
overview.subtitle: What needs a reply now across your widgets.
overview.deleteConfirm: Delete the widget “{name}”? Its conversations will no longer be reachable from your site. This can’t be undone.
overview.noOpen: No open conversations. You’re all caught up.
overview.emptySub: A widget is the chat bubble you embed on your site. Create one, paste the snippet and new conversations land in the inbox.

widgetForm.name: Name
widgetForm.lookSub: How the bubble looks on your site and what it says when opened.
widgetForm.welcomePlaceholder: Hi. Tell us what you need.
widgetForm.deleteSub: The chat stops showing on your site. Conversations are deleted with the widget.
widgetForm.formSub: What the visitor fills in before writing. With no fields, they write right away.
widgetForm.noFields: No fields: the visitor writes right away.
widgetForm.botSub: Replies while nobody on the team has answered.
widgetForm.deleteConfirmBody: {count, plural, =0 {The widget has no conversations.} one {# conversation is deleted with its full history.} other {# conversations are deleted with their full history.}} The chat stops showing on your site. This cannot be undone.
widgetForm.localeHint: Automatic uses the language of the page the widget is on, then the visitor's browser.
widgetForm.attributesSub: Fields your team fills in on each conversation, like reason or plan. Required ones must be set before resolving.
widgetForm.attributeNeedsOptions: Each list attribute needs at least one option.
widgetForm.nameAdminOnly: Only workspace admins can rename a widget: its name is the sender of Chat emails.

embed.title: Install code
embed.instructions: Paste this snippet right before the closing body tag of your site.
embed.copyError: Couldn’t copy. Select the code and copy it by hand.

identity.title: Identity verification
identity.description: Sign the visitor’s email on your server so the inbox can trust it. Emails without a valid signature show as not verified and are never matched to CRM contacts on their own.
identity.instructions: On your server, compute an HMAC-SHA256 of the email in lowercase with this secret as the key, as hex. Pass it as userHash to window.zsChat.identify, along with email and name. Never put the secret in the page.
identity.regenerateHint: Regenerating the secret makes signatures made with the old one stop working.
identity.off: Off. Emails sent by the widget are shown as not verified.
identity.adminOnly: Only workspace owners and admins can see and change the secret.

inbox.title: Inbox
inbox.emptyOpen: No open conversations. You’re all caught up.
inbox.noWidgetsSub: Conversations arrive through a widget on your site. Create one to start receiving chats here.
inbox.keysSend: Send the reply (Shift+Enter for a new line)

visitorPanel.title: Visitor
visitorPanel.name: Name
visitorPanel.crmError: Couldn't save to the CRM. Try again.
visitorPanel.needsEmail: Ask for an email to create a CRM contact.
visitorPanel.confirmUnverified: This email isn’t verified and matches an existing CRM contact. Save the chat there only if you confirmed it’s this person.

people.title: People
people.notesPlaceholder: Context about this person for the team
people.subtitle: Everyone who wrote through one of your widgets.
people.emptyBody: Every visitor who starts a conversation shows up here with their history.
people.notesHint: Saves when you leave the field. Only your team sees it.
people.notesError: Couldn’t save the note. Try again.

rules.title: Assignment rules
rules.timeZoneHint: Evaluated in {zone} (the widget's office-hours time zone).
rules.sub: Rules run top to bottom: the first one that matches assigns the new conversation.
rules.emptySub: Route conversations by keyword or time of day, or spread them round-robin across your team.
rules.namePlaceholder: Rule name, e.g. Pricing questions to sales
rules.name: Name

sla.title: SLA
sla.policiesNote: Targets per priority for this widget, in minutes. For no resolution target, leave the field empty.
sla.allDefault: All four priorities use the default: first response in 60 min, no resolution target.

csat.title: CSAT
csat.note: Visitors are asked to rate their experience (1–5) when a conversation is resolved.

bot.title: AI bot
bot.disabled: Bot is off. Visitors only talk to humans.
bot.greetingPlaceholder: Hi! I'm the assistant. Let me help you…
bot.hint: The bot replies once per conversation, only if nobody has answered yet. It scores visitor keywords against the source (title matches weigh double); without a match it sends just the greeting.
bot.hintAi: The AI bot answers every visitor message until a teammate replies, using only your public Docs pages and this widget's saved replies as knowledge. When it is unsure or the visitor asks for a person, it hands off: the conversation is flagged high priority in the inbox. If AI fails or the monthly quota runs out, the keyword bot answers instead.
bot.aiNotConfigured: AI is not configured on this server (set AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY). Until then the bot uses keyword matching over Docs and saved replies.
bot.hintAgent: This widget is answered by an AI agent. Its instructions, knowledge and tools are managed in Agents → Channels. The agent stops when a teammate replies or it hands off.

officeHours.title: Office hours
officeHours.disabled: No office hours: the widget is always online.
officeHours.hint: Outside these hours the widget shows an away message with the expected response time.

canned.title: Saved replies
canned.sub: Type / in a conversation to insert one.
canned.emptySub: Save answers you type often and insert them with / while replying.
canned.shortcutHelp: Comes from the name. Type it in a conversation to insert the text.
canned.shortcutTaken: There’s already a reply with the {shortcut} shortcut.

attachments.dragDrop: Drag and drop a file here
attachments.skipped: {count, plural, one {# attachment was} other {# attachments were}} not saved: {reason}.

errors.invalid_input: Some fields are invalid. Check them and try again.
errors.invalid_assignee: That person can't be assigned to this conversation.
errors.loadFailed: Couldn’t load. Check your connection and retry.
errors.pageBody: It may be the connection or an error on our side. Retry; if it keeps happening, tell us from Feedback.
errors.missingAttributes: Fill in the required attributes before resolving.
errors.invalidAttribute: That value doesn’t fit the attribute.

quick.hint: Enter to create · Esc to cancel
quick.widgetNote: Next you’ll get the snippet to paste on your site. Welcome message, fields, bot and office hours can be set there too.

reports.title: Reports
reports.subtitle: Conversations created in the range, by agent.
reports.note: Times are averages from when the conversation was created. First response measures the first reply from a teammate: bot replies are not counted, so a conversation only the bot answered shows a dash. CSAT from 1 to 5.
reports.csatLabel: CSAT ({count, plural, one {# response} other {# responses}})
reports.botNote: A conversation counts as resolved by the bot when it was resolved and no teammate replied.
reports.slaNote: Against each widget’s SLA for the priority (60 minutes for the first response if there is none). Open conversations past their target count as late.
reports.hoursCaption: New conversations by day and hour ({zone})
reports.hoursNote: New conversations by day and hour, in {zone}.

notes.label: Internal note
notes.hint: Internal note… only your team sees it. @ to mention
notes.footHint: Only your team sees it. @ to mention.

macros.title: Applied when the reply is sent in a conversation.

help.title: Help
help.hint: The widget adds a tab with your published Docs articles and suggests them while the visitor types a question.

widgets.title: Widgets
widgets.subtitle: Each widget is the chat bubble for one site, with its code, bot, hours, rules and replies.

away.label: Your status
away.awayHint: Round-robin rules skip you while you are away.
away.reassigned: {count, plural, =0 {You are away. You had no open chats to reassign.} one {You are away. # chat went to another teammate.} other {You are away. # chats went to other teammates.}}

edit.deleted: Message deleted. The visitor no longer sees it.
edit.label: Edit message
edit.visitorSees: The visitor sees the new text with an "edited" mark.

offlineEmail.setting: Email replies the visitor hasn’t seen
offlineEmail.hint: If the visitor left an email and doesn’t read a teammate’s reply in time, we send it to them with a link back to the chat. With the email channel set up (Email tab), replying to that email reaches the inbox.
offlineEmail.subject: New reply from {widget}
offlineEmail.heading: You have a new reply
offlineEmail.noLink: To reply, open the chat on the site where you wrote to us.
offlineEmail.noReply: Replies to this email don’t reach the team; answer in the chat.
offlineEmail.why: You get this email because you left your address in the chat and haven’t seen this reply yet.
offlineEmail.canReply: You can reply to this email: your answer reaches the team.

transcriptUi.title: Transcript
transcriptUi.emailHint: Goes to {email}, without internal notes or deleted messages.
transcriptUi.needsEmail: The visitor hasn’t left an email, so the transcript can only be downloaded.
transcriptUi.sendFailed: The email couldn’t be sent. Try again in a moment.
transcriptUi.rateLimited: This transcript was sent several times in the last hour. Try again later.

transcript.title: Conversation with {widget}
transcript.emailIntro: Here is a copy of your chat with {widget}.
transcript.emailFooter: Replies to this email don’t reach the team. To keep talking, open the chat on the site.

merge.hint: Merging moves the messages, tags and attributes into this conversation and removes the other one.

merge.systemNote: {count, plural, one {Merged # message from a conversation started {when}.} other {Merged # messages from a conversation started {when}.}}

teams.invalid: That team isn’t in this workspace.
teams.label: Team
teams.title: Teams
teams.sub: Each team gets its own inbox in the sidebar. Rules can send conversations to a team and spread them among its members.
teams.adminOnly: Only workspace admins can create and edit teams.
teams.emptySub: Create teams like Support or Sales to split the inbox and route conversations to the right people.
teams.name: Name
teams.deleteBody: Delete {name}? Its conversations stay in the inbox without a team and rules that sent work to it stop assigning a team.
teams.pageSub: Team inboxes and routing for Chat.

views.missing: This view no longer exists or isn’t shared with you.
views.name: View name
views.followingEmpty: You aren’t following any conversation that matches. Use Follow in a conversation to get its new messages.

views.emptySub: Set the filters you use every day in the inbox and pick Save as view.

alerts.soundHint: Plays in this browser while the inbox is open.
alerts.unsupported: This browser doesn’t support push notifications.
alerts.pushDisabled: Push isn’t set up on this server.
alerts.pushHint: You get a notification for conversations assigned to you, the ones you follow and new ones in your widgets, also with the inbox closed. On a phone, add the app to the home screen first.
alerts.denied: The browser blocked notifications. Allow them in the site settings.
alerts.pushOn: Push is on for this device.
alerts.pushFailed: Couldn’t turn on push. Try again.

follow.hint: Get notified of new messages without being assigned

variables.missing: No value for {names}: check the reply before sending.
variables.unknown: Unknown variable {names}: it goes out as written. Use name, first_name, email, agent_name, agent_first_name, widget or an attribute id.

copilot.label: AI
copilot.disabled: AI is off for this workspace.
copilot.quota: You used this month’s AI quota.
copilot.rateLimited: Too many AI requests. Wait a minute.
copilot.noMessages: There are no messages to work with yet.
copilot.failed: The AI couldn’t answer. Try again.

outbound.title: Outbound messages
outbound.sub: A message or a 1 to 5 survey that shows up on your site by page, time on page and audience. Each visitor sees it once.
outbound.emptySub: Greet visitors on the pricing page or ask how their visit went.
outbound.name: Name
outbound.question: Question
outbound.questionPlaceholder: How easy was it to find what you needed?
outbound.chatHint: If the visitor replies, the conversation starts with this message and you see it in the inbox.
outbound.surveyHint: Answers from 1 to 5 with an optional comment. The average shows up in this list.
outbound.needsBody: Write the message before turning it on.
outbound.deleteBody: Delete {name}? Its counts and survey answers are deleted too.
outbound.adminOnly: Only workspace admins create and edit outbound messages.

hints.banner: A bar across the top of the page, once per visitor.
hints.post: First line is the title, the rest the text. Opens in the center of the page.
hints.checklist: First line is the title, then one item per line. Progress is saved in the visitor’s browser.
hints.tour: One step per line: CSS selector | text. For example: #pricing | See the plans here. Steps whose element isn’t on the page are skipped.

emailChannel.title: Email
emailChannel.sub: Bring support emails into the inbox and answer them from here.
emailChannel.forward: Forward your support address (for example support@yourcompany.com) to this one. Each email opens or continues a conversation on the Email channel.
emailChannel.pointNew: Replies from the inbox go out by email within the next minute, with the widget name as the sender and this conversation as the reply-to, in the same email thread.
emailChannel.pointReply: When a visitor answers an email we sent, the answer lands in the same conversation.
emailChannel.pointOffline: Quoted text and signatures are removed, attachments are kept and automatic replies or bounces are ignored. The bot doesn’t answer emails.
emailChannel.off: The email channel isn’t set up on this server.
emailChannel.offHint: The admin sets CHAT_INBOUND_DOMAIN, points its MX to Resend Inbound and adds the email.received webhook to /api/chat/inbound-email with RESEND_WEBHOOK_SECRET.

track.title: Track
track.alreadyLinked: This conversation is already linked to that issue.
track.notFound: No issue with that ID in your workspace.
track.noProject: Pick a team you have access to.
track.noProjects: You have no Track teams yet.

access.title: Who can see this inbox
access.sub: Open by default to the whole workspace. Restrict it and only admins and the people you pick can see its conversations, reports and settings.
access.adminOnly: Only workspace admins can change this.
access.membersHelp: Admins always have access. Rules only assign to people on this list.

routing.title: Skills and capacity
routing.sub: A rule with a required skill goes only to people with that skill. Capacity is the most open conversations someone gets from round robin.
routing.requiredSkillHint: Spreads among available people with this skill, under their capacity. If nobody qualifies, the next rule runs.

companies.title: Companies
companies.sub: Group people by company and keep their plan and notes.
companies.emptySub: Create one and pick it on a person’s profile.
companies.deleteBody: “{name}” will be deleted. Its people stay, without a company.
companies.name: Name

reportsCustom.title: Custom reports
reportsCustom.sub: Pick a metric and how to group it. Saved reports run over the inboxes each person can see.
reportsCustom.emptySub: For example: first response by team, last 30 days.
reportsCustom.name: Name
reportsCustom.total: {count, plural, one {# conversation} other {# conversations}} in the range

campaigns.title: Campaigns
campaigns.sub: Email the people of a widget. Each email has an unsubscribe link and people who left aren’t emailed again.
campaigns.emptySub: Write one and send it to people with a known email.
campaigns.adminOnly: Only workspace admins can create and send campaigns.
campaigns.deleteBody: “{name}” will be deleted, with its results.
campaigns.name: Name
campaigns.subject: Subject
campaigns.bodyHelp: You can use '{{first_name|there}}', '{{name}}' and '{{email}}'. A sent campaign can only be renamed.
campaigns.confirmBody: “{name}” goes to {count, plural, one {# person} other {# people}}. This can’t be undone.
campaigns.missingBody: Add a subject and a message before sending.

importer.title: Import conversations
importer.sub: Bring your history from Intercom or Crisp with the JSON of their APIs. Imported conversations don’t run rules or the bot, and importing a file twice doesn’t duplicate.
importer.fileHelp: Intercom: GET /conversations/'{id}' results. Crisp: conversations with session_id and messages. Up to 20 MB and 2,000 conversations.
importer.nothing_to_import: No Intercom or Crisp conversations with messages in that file.

insights.title: Topics and CX score
insights.sub: {count, plural, one {# conversation} other {# conversations}} in this range. Computed from words and timings, without AI.
insights.cxHelp: Uses CSAT when there is one; otherwise first response speed and whether it was resolved.
insights.noTopics: Not enough conversations to find topics.
